Local Presence & Support Clause Only those bidders who have a registered office, service centre, or operational branch within the State of West Bengal for Event Management Services shall be eligible to participate in this bid. Documentary proof such as GST registration, trade license, or lease/utility bill showing operational presence within the state m ust be uploaded. 2. Verification of Local Capability The Buyer reserves the right to physically verify the bidder’s claimed local establishment and manpower b efore evaluation. Any misrepresentation shall lead to disqualification and blacklisting as per GeM rules. 3. Minimum Experience within the State The bidder must have successfully completed at least 1 (one) similar work of Event Management within the State of West Bengal during the last 3 (three) years for any Govt/PSU organization. Relevant completion ce rtificate or work order from a Government or PSU authority within the state must be uploaded as proof, wit h details of organization , the details of project officer , and also contact details for the purpose of verification of the claim. 4. Mandatory Site Visit Certificate Bidders are required to visit the project site before submitting their bid and must upload a ‘Site Visit Certifi cate’ signed by the authorized buyer representative. Bids without such certificate will be treated as non-re sponsive. This is required as the event dates are fixed beforehand and serious bidders are only requested t o participate. The ground conditions must be known to the bidder and no extension of the event would be p ossible. . 9. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Generic Registration / Empanelment Requirement: Contract shall be awarded to only such sellers , who are registered / empanelled / approved / enlisted with TRADE LICENSE IN THE STATE OF WEST BENGAL for the required goods / service category on the date of bid opening. Prospective bidders (if not already registered), are advised to get themselves registered with the said registration authority before bid opening date. (It is certified that the registration is granted by the registering agency as per Rule 150 of GFR following a fair, transparent and reasonable procedure.) 13. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name CMPDI LTD, REGIONAL INSTITUTE, ASANSOL Account No. 11214095558 IFSC Code SBIN0000011 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address ASANSOL . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract.
